items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: Paul Griffin and I both played on that so I know which is which.

ctx.x: Do you ever hear yourself on the radio on some of those pop tunes? Or do you not listen to those kind of stations?
Memorable ones, yeah. I can hear myself. Like “American Pie” or something, I can hear that. Paul Griffin and I both played on that so I know which is which.
Were you playing the acoustic on that tune?
